rawText: SASSICAIA 2022 BOLGHERI SASSICAIA Denominazione di Origine Controllata Tenuta San Guido - Castagneto Carducci ITALIA 750ml 13.5% Imported by Amrel Wines Ltd, WA 0LG UK
description: Sassicaia is produced by Tenuta San Guido in the Bolgheri area of coastal Tuscany, from vineyards planted with Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc on soils with significant stony, galestro-like composition that give the wine its name (sasso meaning stone). It was the first wine to define the Bolgheri Sassicaia DOC, a sub-zone created specifically for this estate in 1994. The wine is aged in French oak barriques for approximately 18-24 months before release.
